title: Adding a negSucc integer into a normalized difference, at the representation level
statement: For naturals a, b and c, -(a+1) + subNatNat(b, c) = subNatNat(b, c + (a+1)) -- a representation-level lemma folding a negSucc-constructed addend into subNatNat's second argument.

formal.statement: theorem Int.negSucc_add_subNatNat : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.add (Int.negSucc x0) (Int.subNatNat x1 x2)) (Int.subNatNat x1 (AxNat.add x2 (AxNat.succ x0))))))
